title: swa-superior-2000-world-heavyweight
label: Viper

won.source: Pinned Maverick with the V-10 on the 15 June 2001 Fusion.

lost.source: Mike Powers is champion by the promotion's own line-up of 21 November 2001; no losing card survives.

how: Won by pinfall with the V-10 onto the title belt.
note: Retained against Zack Payne on the 17 August 2001 Fusion and was billed to defend against Mike Powers at Back to School on 1 September 2001.

title: swa-superior-2000-world-heavyweight
label: Maverick

won.source: Champion as of the promotion's own info packet of 11 June 2001; no won-date survives.

lost.source: Lost to Viper on the 15 June 2001 Fusion.

how: Billed at the 15 June 2001 Fusion as the longest-reigning champion in the promotion's history.

title: swa-superior-2000-world-heavyweight
label: Mike Powers

won.source: Champion by the promotion's own Holiday Havok line-up of 21 November 2001; Van Hammer's promo of 24 November says he won it from Viper.

lost.source: No title change survives in the promotion's held documents.

how: Won from Viper; the card is not held.
note: Billed to defend against Van Hammer at Holiday Havok on 30 November 2001.

title: swa-superior-2000-television
label: Charles Purnell

won.source: Champion by the promotion's own line-up of 12 August 2001.
